property_summary: For any caller who previously deposited X wei, calling withdrawAll always sends X wei to msg.sender and leaves their recorded credit at 0; the mutant that reads credit[address(this)] can attempt to send a non-matching amount (or zero) and thus will either send the wrong value or revert — breaking this invariant for some deposit amounts and callers.
change_summary: Replace reading credit[msg.sender] with reading credit[address(this)] to use a different key, changing which calls revert when withdrawing.
